## Change

Describe the user-visible problem, resulting behavior, and affected sign-in methods/apps.

## Validation

- [ ] Complete `pnpm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Relevant new regressions were demonstrated failing before the fix.
- [ ] Account recovery, keyboard access, and narrow screens were checked where relevant.
- [ ] API docs and migration SQL/snapshots match any backend changes.
- [ ] An auth-client contract change includes a version/publishing plan for consuming apps.

Do not include passwords, session cookies, email tokens, account exports, or other private data.
